<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>grabient kY4mpDazO-mUuu_fuLqXU49dvVP6</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
  canvas { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas></canvas>
<script>
// The glass's colors (the site takes six along the palette; any number will do), the angle its ribs run at
// (90 as designed), its shape (0 as designed, up to 999), how fast it plays (1 as designed, 0 holds the first
// frame), frames a second at most, and the seconds it takes to ease in.
const COLORS = ["#fad95c", "#f9c251", "#ffa270", "#fd80a4", "#fe66cd", "#fe59d2"];
const ANGLE = 90;
const SHAPE = 0;
const SPEED = 1;
const FPS = 60;
const EASE = 1.6;
</script>
<script type="x-shader/x-vertex" id="disc-vs">#version 300 es
layout(location=0) in vec2 corner;
layout(location=1) in vec4 disc;   // middle x, y and radius in field texels (y down), core
layout(location=2) in vec3 color;
uniform vec2 uField;
out vec2 vLocal; out vec3 vColor; flat out float vCore;
void main() {
  vec2 pos = disc.xy + corner * disc.z;
  vLocal = corner; vColor = color; vCore = disc.w;
  gl_Position = vec4(pos.x / uField.x * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0 - pos.y / uField.y * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}</script>
<script type="x-shader/x-fragment" id="disc-fs">#version 300 es
precision highp float;
in vec2 vLocal; in vec3 vColor; flat in float vCore;
out vec4 o;
void main() {
  float r = length(vLocal);
  if (r >= 1.0) discard;
  float a = r <= vCore ? 1.0 : (1.0 - r) / (1.0 - vCore);
  o = vec4(vColor * a, a);
}</script>
<script type="x-shader/x-vertex" id="full-vs">#version 300 es
layout(location=0) in vec2 corner;
void main() { gl_Position = vec4(corner, 0.0, 1.0); }</script>
<script type="x-shader/x-fragment" id="blur-fs">#version 300 es
precision highp float;
uniform sampler2D uSrc;
uniform vec2 uStep;
uniform vec2 uTaps[6];
out vec4 o;
void main() {
  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / vec2(textureSize(uSrc, 0));
  vec3 c = texture(uSrc, uv).rgb * uTaps[0].y;
  for (int i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
    vec2 off = uStep * uTaps[i].x;
    c += (texture(uSrc, uv + off).rgb + texture(uSrc, uv - off).rgb) * uTaps[i].y;
  }
  o = vec4(c, 1.0);
}</script>
<script type="x-shader/x-fragment" id="final-fs">#version 300 es
precision highp float;
uniform sampler2D uMap;
uniform sampler2D uFieldT;
uniform float uH;
uniform vec2 uOrigin;
uniform vec2 uOffset;
uniform vec2 uInv;
uniform float uScale;
out vec4 o;
void main() {
  ivec2 p = ivec2(gl_FragCoord.x, uH - gl_FragCoord.y);
  vec3 m = texelFetch(uMap, p, 0).rgb;
  vec2 s = vec2(p) + uOffset + floor(uScale * (m.rg - 0.5) + 0.5);
  vec2 f = (s + 0.5 - uOrigin) * uInv;
  vec3 c = texture(uFieldT, vec2(f.x, 1.0 - f.y)).rgb;
  o = vec4(min(vec3(1.0), floor(c * 255.0 + 0.5) / 255.0 * (2.0 * m.b)), 1.0);
}</script>
<script type="x-shader/x-fragment" id="bake-fs">#version 300 es
precision highp float;
precision highp int;
uniform highp sampler2D uRibs;   // a row a rib: [cx, cy, r², 0], then each stop [offset, gray, 0, 0]
uniform int uCount;              // ribs
uniform int uStops;              // stops a rib
uniform vec2 uOrigin;            // the window's corner in the geometry's pixels
uniform vec4 uLine;              // the normal's line: x1, y1, x2 − x1, y2 − y1
uniform vec3 uNormals[17];       // the normal's stops: offset, red, green
uniform float uShade[17];        // the ribs' light, half the factor, at 16ths of the lens gray
out vec4 o;
vec2 stopAt(int rib, int k) { return texelFetch(uRibs, ivec2(1 + k, rib), 0).xy; }
void main() {
  /* the pixel's center in the geometry's pixels: a texel row is the CPU's row */
  vec2 p = gl_FragCoord.xy + uOrigin;
  /* the smallest disc holding it, painted last, so on top: the first in the ribs' order */
  int rib = -1;
  for (int k = 0; k < 256; k++) {
    if (k >= uCount) break;
    vec4 r = texelFetch(uRibs, ivec2(0, k), 0);
    vec2 d = p - r.xy;
    if (dot(d, d) <= r.z) { rib = k; break; }
  }
  float A = 128.0;
  if (rib >= 0) {
    vec4 r = texelFetch(uRibs, ivec2(0, rib), 0);
    vec2 d = p - r.xy;
    float t = sqrt(dot(d, d) / r.z);
    vec2 first = stopAt(rib, 0);
    vec2 last = stopAt(rib, uStops - 1);
    if (t <= first.x) A = first.y;
    else if (t > last.x) A = last.y;
    else {
      int lo = 0;
      int hi = uStops - 1;
      for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        if (hi - lo <= 1) break;
        int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (t <= stopAt(rib, mid).x) hi = mid; else lo = mid;
      }
      vec2 s0 = stopAt(rib, lo);
      vec2 s1 = stopAt(rib, lo + 1);
      float f = s1.x > s0.x ? (t - s0.x) / (s1.x - s0.x) : 1.0;
      A = s0.y + f * (s1.y - s0.y);
    }
    A = floor(A + 0.5);
  }
  float tn = clamp(dot(p - uLine.xy, uLine.zw) / dot(uLine.zw, uLine.zw), 0.0, 1.0);
  vec2 n;
  if (tn <= uNormals[0].x) n = uNormals[0].yz;
  else if (tn > uNormals[16].x) n = uNormals[16].yz;
  else {
    int k = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { if (tn > uNormals[i + 1].x) k = i + 1; }
    vec3 n0 = uNormals[k];
    vec3 n1 = uNormals[k + 1];
    float f = n1.x > n0.x ? (tn - n0.x) / (n1.x - n0.x) : 1.0;
    n = n0.yz + f * (n1.yz - n0.yz);
  }
  n = floor(n + 0.5);
  float a = A / 255.0;
  vec2 an = n / 255.0;
  vec2 v = clamp(2.0 * a * an - a - an + 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  float c = a * 16.0;
  int kk = min(15, int(floor(c)));
  float light = uShade[kk] + (c - float(kk)) * (uShade[kk + 1] - uShade[kk]);
  o = vec4(floor(255.0 * v + 0.5) / 255.0, floor(255.0 * light + 0.5) / 255.0, 1.0);
}</script>
<script>
// The design, as the site draws it: the hill climb's numbers. Lengths are in the box's diagonal, or in pixels at
// the reference's 720 by 900 (diagonal REF_D), scaled to the box.
const T = {
  seed: 7,
  geo: { arcC: [-0.6939, -0.6395], arcDir: [0.72384, 0.68997], arcR0: 0.74155, arcG: 0.73876, s0: 0.088544, p0: 0.016224, betaP: 0.18037, betaM: 0.13328, phase: 6.2201 },
  lensA: 1.8221723373606658,
  lensB: 1.3527826156950404,
  lensE: 0.6739178404790045,
  lensKappa: 0.97,
  lensShift: 0.15084155110105363,
  seamW: 13.089314648014595,
  disp: 0.8615750162531419,
  nPts: 12,
  gridX: 4,
  spread: 1.1750951232721354,
  jitter: 0.12508013085004963,
  sigma: 0.10825287299504333,
  orbitAlong: 0.1979667332590454,
  orbitAcross: 0.03473221296011865,
  discScale: 2.3983953901883925,
  core: 0.3626018216611724,
  blur: 28.823670270874572,
  base: 1,
  lensStops: 28,
  shade: 0.058023170773981086,
  shadeSkew: 0.3
};
const REF_D = 1152.56;
const DESIGN = 1000;
const LOOP = 56;
const DESIGN_ANGLE = 90;
const r2 = v => Math.round(v * 100) / 100;
const r3 = v => Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000;
const r4 = v => Math.round(v * 10000) / 10000;

// mulberry32: the design's random numbers, the same everywhere.
function dice(seed) {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
// A shape's seed, scrambled so near shapes draw unlike ones.
const seedOf = shape => (Math.imul(shape + 1, 0x9e3779b1) ^ 0x5bd1e995) >>> 0;

// The ribs a shape draws: the design's for 0, another's a little wider or narrower and widening faster or slower.
function geoOf(shape) {
  if (!shape) return T.geo;
  const rand = dice(seedOf(shape) ^ 0x2545f491);
  const between = (least, most) => least + (most - least) * rand();
  rand();
  const widen = between(0.8, 1.25);
  return {
    ...T.geo,
    p0: T.geo.p0 * between(0.8, 1.3),
    betaP: T.geo.betaP * widen,
    betaM: T.geo.betaM * widen,
    phase: T.geo.phase + rand()
  };
}

// The ribs: circles |p - (C + s dir)| = R0 + g s, p from the box's middle in diagonals, the pitch in s growing away
// from s0, so the rib index k(s) is a logarithm; `turn` turns them about the middle.
function ribs(W, H, turn, geo) {
  const c = Math.cos(turn);
  const sn = Math.sin(turn);
  const rot = v => [v[0] * c - v[1] * sn, v[0] * sn + v[1] * c];
  const g = { ...geo, arcC: rot(geo.arcC), arcDir: rot(geo.arcDir) };
  const D = Math.hypot(W, H);
  const levelAt = (X, Y) => {
    const q0 = (X - W / 2) / D - g.arcC[0];
    const q1 = (Y - H / 2) / D - g.arcC[1];
    const a2 = 1 - g.arcG * g.arcG;
    const b2 = -2 * (q0 * g.arcDir[0] + q1 * g.arcDir[1] + g.arcG * g.arcR0);
    const c2 = q0 * q0 + q1 * q1 - g.arcR0 * g.arcR0;
    return (-b2 - Math.sqrt(Math.max(b2 * b2 - 4 * a2 * c2, 0))) / (2 * a2);
  };
  const kOf = s => {
    const ds = s - g.s0;
    const b = ds >= 0 ? g.betaP : g.betaM;
    return (
      (b > 1e-5 ? (Math.sign(ds) * Math.log(1 + (b * Math.abs(ds)) / g.p0)) / b : ds / g.p0) +
      g.phase
    );
  };
  const sOf = k => {
    let lo = -5;
    let hi = 5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      const m = (lo + hi) / 2;
      if (kOf(m) < k) lo = m;
      else hi = m;
    }
    return (lo + hi) / 2;
  };
  return { g, D, levelAt, kOf, sOf };
}

// The ribs' tangent at the middle in degrees, which the colors' orbits lie along.
function alphaOf(angle, shape) {
  const turn = ((angle - DESIGN_ANGLE) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const c = Math.cos(turn);
  const sn = Math.sin(turn);
  const [x, y] = geoOf(shape).arcC;
  const cxA = -(x * c - y * sn);
  const cyA = -(x * sn + y * c);
  const nA = Math.hypot(cxA, cyA);
  return r3((Math.atan2(-cxA / nA, cyA / nA) * 180) / Math.PI);
}

// The lens across a rib, in pitches, v from -1 (its inner edge) to 1 (its outer).
const lensF = v =>
  -(
    T.lensA * v +
    T.lensB * v ** 3 +
    T.lensE * (v / Math.sqrt(Math.max(1 - T.lensKappa * T.lensKappa * v * v, 1e-3)) - v)
  ) + T.lensShift;

// What a size draws, whatever the colors: the ribs and their lens grays, the normal, the light, the blur and the
// filter's region.
function geometry(W, H, angle, shape) {
  const { g, D, levelAt, kOf, sOf } = ribs(W, H, ((angle - DESIGN_ANGLE) * Math.PI) / 180, geoOf(shape));
  const u = D / REF_D;
  const edgeK = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 16; i++) {
    for (const [x, y] of [
      [(i * W) / 16, 0],
      [(i * W) / 16, H],
      [0, (i * H) / 16],
      [W, (i * H) / 16]
    ])
      edgeK.push(kOf(levelAt(x, y)));
  }
  const k0 = Math.floor(Math.min(...edgeK)) - 1;
  const k1 = Math.ceil(Math.max(...edgeK)) + 1;
  const N = T.lensStops;
  const seamPx = Math.max(T.seamW * u, 1.2);
  const raw = [];
  let dmax = 1;
  for (let k = k0; k < k1; k++) {
    const sIn = sOf(k);
    const sOut = sOf(k + 1);
    const cx = W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + sOut * g.arcDir[0]) * D;
    const cy = H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + sOut * g.arcDir[1]) * D;
    const R = (g.arcR0 + g.arcG * sOut) * D;
    const pitch = (sOut - sIn) * (1 + g.arcG) * D;
    const seam = seamPx / pitch;
    const stops = [];
    for (let j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
      const x = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos((Math.PI * j) / N);
      const e = Math.abs(x - 0.5) - 0.5;
      const tt = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e + seam) / (2 * seam)));
      const band = tt * tt * (3 - 2 * tt);
      const uf = x * (1 - band) + (1 - x) * band;
      const d = lensF(2 * uf - 1) * pitch * T.disp;
      dmax = Math.max(dmax, Math.abs(d));
      stops.push([(R - pitch + x * pitch) / R, d]);
    }
    raw.push({ cx, cy, R, stops });
  }
  dmax *= 1.02;
  const scale = r2(2 * dmax);
  const ribList = raw.map(r => ({
    cx: r2(r.cx),
    cy: r2(r.cy),
    r: r2(r.R),
    stops: r.stops.map(([o, d]) => [
      r4(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, o))),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * d) / (scale / 2)))
    ])
  }));
  const sMid = levelAt(W / 2, H / 2);
  const cm = [
    W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + sMid * g.arcDir[0]) * D,
    H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + sMid * g.arcDir[1]) * D
  ];
  const nl = Math.hypot(W / 2 - cm[0], H / 2 - cm[1]);
  const n0 = [(W / 2 - cm[0]) / nl, (H / 2 - cm[1]) / nl];
  const t0 = [-n0[1], n0[0]];
  const L = Math.abs(W * t0[0]) + Math.abs(H * t0[1]);
  const nStops = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= 16; j++) {
    const x = -L / 2 + (L * j) / 16;
    const X = W / 2 + t0[0] * x;
    const Y = H / 2 + t0[1] * x;
    const s = levelAt(X, Y);
    const c = [
      W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + s * g.arcDir[0]) * D,
      H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + s * g.arcDir[1]) * D
    ];
    const l = Math.hypot(X - c[0], Y - c[1]);
    nStops.push([
      r4(j / 16),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * (X - c[0])) / l)),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * (Y - c[1])) / l))
    ]);
  }
  const normal = {
    x1: r2(W / 2 - (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y1: r2(H / 2 - (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    x2: r2(W / 2 + (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y2: r2(H / 2 + (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    stops: nStops
  };
  const alpha = alphaOf(angle, shape);
  const sigma = r2(T.blur * u);
  const dBox = Math.floor((sigma * 3 * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)) / 4 + 0.5);
  const sigmaEff = Math.sqrt(
    dBox % 2 ? (dBox * dBox - 1) / 4 : (3 * dBox * dBox + 2 * dBox - 2) / 12
  );
  const shadeTable = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => {
    const x = (2 * i) / 16 - 1;
    return r4(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 0.5 * (1 + T.shade * (T.shadeSkew * x - x * x + 1 / 3)))));
  });
  const move = Math.ceil(scale / 2) + 1;
  const reach = Math.ceil(1.5 * dBox) + 1;
  const region = {
    x: -move - reach,
    y: -move - reach,
    w: W + 2 * (move + reach),
    h: H + 2 * (move + reach)
  };
  return {
    width: W,
    height: H,
    angle,
    shape: shape ?? 0,
    D,
    ribs: ribList,
    normal,
    scale,
    alpha,
    sigma,
    sigmaEff,
    dBox,
    shadeTable,
    region
  };
}

// The colors' discs: the base, then twelve soft discs riding ellipses along the ribs.
function field(geometry, colors) {
  const { width: W, height: H, D } = geometry;
  const rand = dice(geometry.shape ? seedOf(geometry.shape) : T.seed);
  const rows = Math.ceil(T.nPts / T.gridX);
  const discs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < T.nPts; i++) {
    const gx = ((i % T.gridX) + 0.5) / T.gridX;
    const gy = (Math.floor(i / T.gridX) + 0.5) / rows;
    const bx = (gx - 0.5) * W * T.spread + (rand() - 0.5) * W * T.jitter;
    const by = (gy - 0.5) * H * T.spread + (rand() - 0.5) * H * T.jitter;
    const laps = (rand() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2) * (rand() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
    const th0 = rand();
    rand();
    const a = r2(Math.max(0.5, T.orbitAlong * D * (0.7 + 0.6 * rand())));
    const b = r2(Math.max(0.5, T.orbitAcross * D * (0.7 + 0.6 * rand())));
    const R = r2(T.sigma * D * (0.85 + 0.3 * rand()) * T.discScale);
    const dur = r3(LOOP / Math.abs(laps));
    const delay = r3(-th0 * dur);
    discs.push({
      cx: r2(W / 2 + bx),
      cy: r2(H / 2 + by),
      a,
      b,
      R,
      dur,
      delay,
      dir: laps > 0 ? 1 : -1,
      color: colors[i % colors.length]
    });
  }
  return { base: colors[T.base % colors.length], core: r4(T.core), discs };
}

// A disc's middle at t, seconds of the loop at speed 1, into out[k] and out[k + 1].
function discAt(geometry, d, t, out, k) {
  const ang = (d.dir * 2 * Math.PI * (t - d.delay)) / d.dur;
  const al = (geometry.alpha * Math.PI) / 180;
  const ex = d.a * Math.cos(ang);
  const ey = d.b * Math.sin(ang);
  out[k] = d.cx + ex * Math.cos(al) - ey * Math.sin(al);
  out[k + 1] = d.cy + ex * Math.sin(al) + ey * Math.cos(al);
}

// The one design scaled to cover a canvas of w by h device pixels, and the part of it the canvas shows.
function cover(width, height, angle, shape) {
  const k = Math.max(width / DESIGN, height / DESIGN);
  const g = geometry(
    Math.max(1, Math.round(DESIGN * k)),
    Math.max(1, Math.round(DESIGN * k)),
    angle,
    shape
  );
  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(width));
  const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(height));
  return { geometry: g, window: { x: Math.round((g.width - w) / 2), y: Math.round((g.height - h) / 2), w, h } };
}

// The field's texture: 1/q of the region, q set so the blur spans about three texels, and its blur as a Gaussian of
// the three boxes' variance, eleven taps a pass (the middle and five bilinear pairs either side).
function plan(geometry) {
  const q = Math.max(1, geometry.sigmaEff / 3);
  const fw = Math.ceil(geometry.region.w / q) + 1;
  const fh = Math.ceil(geometry.region.h / q) + 1;
  const s = geometry.sigmaEff / q;
  const w = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) w.push(Math.exp(-(i * i) / (2 * s * s)));
  const tot = w[0] + 2 * w.slice(1).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const taps = [[0, w[0] / tot]];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 9; i += 2) {
    const a = w[i] / tot;
    const b = w[i + 1] / tot;
    taps.push([i + b / (a + b), a + b]);
  }
  return { q, fw, fh, s, taps };
}

const hexRgb = hex => {
  const n = Number.parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
  return [((n >> 16) & 255) / 255, ((n >> 8) & 255) / 255, (n & 255) / 255];
};

// The player's drawing: the same textures, passes and uniforms, so each frame's GPU work is the player's. A context the
// browser gives back after losing it gets a drawing of its own.
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl2", {
  alpha: false,
  antialias: false,
  depth: false,
  stencil: false,
  premultipliedAlpha: true,
  preserveDrawingBuffer: false
});
if (gl) play();
else document.body.textContent = "This page needs WebGL 2, which this browser does not have.";

function drawing() {
  const compile = (type, id) => {
    const shader = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(shader, document.getElementById(id).textContent);
    gl.compileShader(shader);
    if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) throw new Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader));
    return shader;
  };
  const link = (vertex, fragment) => {
    const program = gl.createProgram();
    gl.attachShader(program, vertex);
    gl.attachShader(program, fragment);
    gl.linkProgram(program);
    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) throw new Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(program));
    return program;
  };
  const full = compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, "full-vs");
  const pDisc = link(compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, "disc-vs"), compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, "disc-fs"));
  const pBlur = link(full, compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, "blur-fs"));
  const pFinal = link(full, compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, "final-fs"));
  const pBake = link(full, compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, "bake-fs"));

  let m = textureLoad(map, p, 0).rgb;
  let s = vec2f(p) + glass.offset + floor(glass.scale * (m.rg - 0.5) + 0.5);
  let f = (s + 0.5 - glass.origin) * glass.inv;
  let c = textureSample(fieldT, bilinear, vec2f(f.x, 1.0 - f.y)).rgb;
  return vec4f(min(vec3f(1.0), floor(c * 255.0 + 0.5) / 255.0 * (2.0 * m.b)), 1.0);
}

<script type="text/wgsl" id="bake">struct Bake {
  origin: vec2f,                 // the canvas's corner in the design's pixels
  count: i32,                    // ribs
  stops: i32,                    // stops a rib
  line: vec4f,                   // the normal's line: x1, y1, x2 - x1, y2 - y1
  normals: array<vec4f, 17>,     // the normal's stops: offset, red, green
  shade: array<vec4f, 17>,       // the ribs' light, half the factor, at 16ths of the lens gray, x
}
// a row a rib: [cx, cy, r squared, 0], then each stop [offset, gray, 0, 0]
@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read> ribs: array<vec4f>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> bake: Bake;

@vertex
fn vs_main(@location(0) corner: vec2f) -> @builtin(position) vec4f {
  return vec4f(corner, 0.0, 1.0);
}

fn stopAt(rib: i32, k: i32) -> vec2f {
  return ribs[rib * (bake.stops + 1) + 1 + k].xy;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(@builtin(position) frag: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f {
  // the pixel's center in the design's pixels
  let p = frag.xy + bake.origin;
  // the smallest disc holding it, painted last, so on top: the first in the ribs' order
  var rib = -1;
  for (var k = 0; k < 256; k++) {
    if (k >= bake.count) {
      break;
    }
    let r = ribs[k * (bake.stops + 1)];
    let d = p - r.xy;
    if (dot(d, d) <= r.z) {
      rib = k;
      break;
    }
  }
  var A = 128.0;
  if (rib >= 0) {
    let r = ribs[rib * (bake.stops + 1)];
    let d = p - r.xy;
    let t = sqrt(dot(d, d) / r.z);
    let first = stopAt(rib, 0);
    let last = stopAt(rib, bake.stops - 1);
    if (t <= first.x) {
      A = first.y;
    } else if (t > last.x) {
      A = last.y;
    } else {
      var lo = 0;
      var hi = bake.stops - 1;
      for (var i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        if (hi - lo <= 1) {
          break;
        }
        let mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (t <= stopAt(rib, mid).x) {
          hi = mid;
        } else {
          lo = mid;
        }
      }
      let s0 = stopAt(rib, lo);
      let s1 = stopAt(rib, lo + 1);
      let f = select(1.0, (t - s0.x) / (s1.x - s0.x), s1.x > s0.x);
      A = s0.y + f * (s1.y - s0.y);
    }
    A = floor(A + 0.5);
  }
  let tn = clamp(dot(p - bake.line.xy, bake.line.zw) / dot(bake.line.zw, bake.line.zw), 0.0, 1.0);
  var n: vec2f;
  if (tn <= bake.normals[0].x) {
    n = bake.normals[0].yz;
  } else if (tn > bake.normals[16].x) {
    n = bake.normals[16].yz;
  } else {
    var k = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      if (tn > bake.normals[i + 1].x) {
        k = i + 1;
      }
    }
    let n0 = bake.normals[k];
    let n1 = bake.normals[k + 1];
    let f = select(1.0, (tn - n0.x) / (n1.x - n0.x), n1.x > n0.x);
    n = n0.yz + f * (n1.yz - n0.yz);
  }
  n = floor(n + 0.5);
  let a = A / 255.0;
  let an = n / 255.0;
  let v = clamp(2.0 * a * an - a - an + 1.0, vec2f(0.0), vec2f(1.0));
  let c = a * 16.0;
  let kk = min(15, i32(floor(c)));
  let light = bake.shade[kk].x + (c - f32(kk)) * (bake.shade[kk + 1].x - bake.shade[kk].x);
  return vec4f(floor(255.0 * v + 0.5) / 255.0, floor(255.0 * light + 0.5) / 255.0, 1.0);
}
</script>
<script type="module">
// The design, as the site draws it: the hill climb's numbers. Lengths are in the box's diagonal, or in pixels at
// the reference's 720 by 900 (diagonal REF_D), scaled to the box.
const T = {
  seed: 7,
  geo: { arcC: [-0.6939, -0.6395], arcDir: [0.72384, 0.68997], arcR0: 0.74155, arcG: 0.73876, s0: 0.088544, p0: 0.016224, betaP: 0.18037, betaM: 0.13328, phase: 6.2201 },
  lensA: 1.8221723373606658,
  lensB: 1.3527826156950404,
  lensE: 0.6739178404790045,
  lensKappa: 0.97,
  lensShift: 0.15084155110105363,
  seamW: 13.089314648014595,
  disp: 0.8615750162531419,
  nPts: 12,
  gridX: 4,
  spread: 1.1750951232721354,
  jitter: 0.12508013085004963,
  sigma: 0.10825287299504333,
  orbitAlong: 0.1979667332590454,
  orbitAcross: 0.03473221296011865,
  discScale: 2.3983953901883925,
  core: 0.3626018216611724,
  blur: 28.823670270874572,
  base: 1,
  lensStops: 28,
  shade: 0.058023170773981086,
  shadeSkew: 0.3
};
const REF_D = 1152.56;
const DESIGN = 1000;
const LOOP = 56;
const DESIGN_ANGLE = 90;
const r2 = v => Math.round(v * 100) / 100;
const r3 = v => Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000;
const r4 = v => Math.round(v * 10000) / 10000;

// mulberry32: the design's random numbers, the same everywhere.
function dice(seed) {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
// A shape's seed, scrambled so near shapes draw unlike ones.
const seedOf = shape => (Math.imul(shape + 1, 0x9e3779b1) ^ 0x5bd1e995) >>> 0;

// The ribs a shape draws: the design's for 0, another's a little wider or narrower and widening faster or slower.
function geoOf(shape) {
  if (!shape) return T.geo;
  const rand = dice(seedOf(shape) ^ 0x2545f491);
  const between = (least, most) => least + (most - least) * rand();
  rand();
  const widen = between(0.8, 1.25);
  return {
    ...T.geo,
    p0: T.geo.p0 * between(0.8, 1.3),
    betaP: T.geo.betaP * widen,
    betaM: T.geo.betaM * widen,
    phase: T.geo.phase + rand()
  };
}

// The ribs: circles |p - (C + s dir)| = R0 + g s, p from the box's middle in diagonals, the pitch in s growing away
// from s0, so the rib index k(s) is a logarithm; `turn` turns them about the middle.
function ribs(W, H, turn, geo) {
  const c = Math.cos(turn);
  const sn = Math.sin(turn);
  const rot = v => [v[0] * c - v[1] * sn, v[0] * sn + v[1] * c];
  const g = { ...geo, arcC: rot(geo.arcC), arcDir: rot(geo.arcDir) };
  const D = Math.hypot(W, H);
  const levelAt = (X, Y) => {
    const q0 = (X - W / 2) / D - g.arcC[0];
    const q1 = (Y - H / 2) / D - g.arcC[1];
    const a2 = 1 - g.arcG * g.arcG;
    const b2 = -2 * (q0 * g.arcDir[0] + q1 * g.arcDir[1] + g.arcG * g.arcR0);
    const c2 = q0 * q0 + q1 * q1 - g.arcR0 * g.arcR0;
    return (-b2 - Math.sqrt(Math.max(b2 * b2 - 4 * a2 * c2, 0))) / (2 * a2);
  };
  const kOf = s => {
    const ds = s - g.s0;
    const b = ds >= 0 ? g.betaP : g.betaM;
    return (
      (b > 1e-5 ? (Math.sign(ds) * Math.log(1 + (b * Math.abs(ds)) / g.p0)) / b : ds / g.p0) +
      g.phase
    );
  };
  const sOf = k => {
    let lo = -5;
    let hi = 5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      const m = (lo + hi) / 2;
      if (kOf(m) < k) lo = m;
      else hi = m;
    }
    return (lo + hi) / 2;
  };
  return { g, D, levelAt, kOf, sOf };
}

// The ribs' tangent at the middle in degrees, which the colors' orbits lie along.
function alphaOf(angle, shape) {
  const turn = ((angle - DESIGN_ANGLE) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const c = Math.cos(turn);
  const sn = Math.sin(turn);
  const [x, y] = geoOf(shape).arcC;
  const cxA = -(x * c - y * sn);
  const cyA = -(x * sn + y * c);
  const nA = Math.hypot(cxA, cyA);
  return r3((Math.atan2(-cxA / nA, cyA / nA) * 180) / Math.PI);
}

// The lens across a rib, in pitches, v from -1 (its inner edge) to 1 (its outer).
const lensF = v =>
  -(
    T.lensA * v +
    T.lensB * v ** 3 +
    T.lensE * (v / Math.sqrt(Math.max(1 - T.lensKappa * T.lensKappa * v * v, 1e-3)) - v)
  ) + T.lensShift;

// What a size draws, whatever the colors: the ribs and their lens grays, the normal, the light, the blur and the
// filter's region.
function geometry(W, H, angle, shape) {
  const { g, D, levelAt, kOf, sOf } = ribs(W, H, ((angle - DESIGN_ANGLE) * Math.PI) / 180, geoOf(shape));
  const u = D / REF_D;
  const edgeK = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 16; i++) {
    for (const [x, y] of [
      [(i * W) / 16, 0],
      [(i * W) / 16, H],
      [0, (i * H) / 16],
      [W, (i * H) / 16]
    ])
      edgeK.push(kOf(levelAt(x, y)));
  }
  const k0 = Math.floor(Math.min(...edgeK)) - 1;
  const k1 = Math.ceil(Math.max(...edgeK)) + 1;
  const N = T.lensStops;
  const seamPx = Math.max(T.seamW * u, 1.2);
  const raw = [];
  let dmax = 1;
  for (let k = k0; k < k1; k++) {
    const sIn = sOf(k);
    const sOut = sOf(k + 1);
    const cx = W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + sOut * g.arcDir[0]) * D;
    const cy = H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + sOut * g.arcDir[1]) * D;
    const R = (g.arcR0 + g.arcG * sOut) * D;
    const pitch = (sOut - sIn) * (1 + g.arcG) * D;
    const seam = seamPx / pitch;
    const stops = [];
    for (let j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
      const x = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos((Math.PI * j) / N);
      const e = Math.abs(x - 0.5) - 0.5;
      const tt = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e + seam) / (2 * seam)));
      const band = tt * tt * (3 - 2 * tt);
      const uf = x * (1 - band) + (1 - x) * band;
      const d = lensF(2 * uf - 1) * pitch * T.disp;
      dmax = Math.max(dmax, Math.abs(d));
      stops.push([(R - pitch + x * pitch) / R, d]);
    }
    raw.push({ cx, cy, R, stops });
  }
  dmax *= 1.02;
  const scale = r2(2 * dmax);
  const ribList = raw.map(r => ({
    cx: r2(r.cx),
    cy: r2(r.cy),
    r: r2(r.R),
    stops: r.stops.map(([o, d]) => [
      r4(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, o))),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * d) / (scale / 2)))
    ])
  }));
  const sMid = levelAt(W / 2, H / 2);
  const cm = [
    W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + sMid * g.arcDir[0]) * D,
    H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + sMid * g.arcDir[1]) * D
  ];
  const nl = Math.hypot(W / 2 - cm[0], H / 2 - cm[1]);
  const n0 = [(W / 2 - cm[0]) / nl, (H / 2 - cm[1]) / nl];
  const t0 = [-n0[1], n0[0]];
  const L = Math.abs(W * t0[0]) + Math.abs(H * t0[1]);
  const nStops = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= 16; j++) {
    const x = -L / 2 + (L * j) / 16;
    const X = W / 2 + t0[0] * x;
    const Y = H / 2 + t0[1] * x;
    const s = levelAt(X, Y);
    const c = [
      W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + s * g.arcDir[0]) * D,
      H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + s * g.arcDir[1]) * D
    ];
    const l = Math.hypot(X - c[0], Y - c[1]);
    nStops.push([
      r4(j / 16),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * (X - c[0])) / l)),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * (Y - c[1])) / l))
    ]);
  }
  const normal = {
    x1: r2(W / 2 - (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y1: r2(H / 2 - (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    x2: r2(W / 2 + (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y2: r2(H / 2 + (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    stops: nStops
  };
  const alpha = alphaOf(angle, shape);
  const sigma = r2(T.blur * u);
  const dBox = Math.floor((sigma * 3 * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)) / 4 + 0.5);
  const sigmaEff = Math.sqrt(
    dBox % 2 ? (dBox * dBox - 1) / 4 : (3 * dBox * dBox + 2 * dBox - 2) / 12
  );
  const shadeTable = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => {
    const x = (2 * i) / 16 - 1;
    return r4(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 0.5 * (1 + T.shade * (T.shadeSkew * x - x * x + 1 / 3)))));
  });
  const move = Math.ceil(scale / 2) + 1;
  const reach = Math.ceil(1.5 * dBox) + 1;
  const region = {
    x: -move - reach,
    y: -move - reach,
    w: W + 2 * (move + reach),
    h: H + 2 * (move + reach)
  };
  return {
    width: W,
    height: H,
    angle,
    shape: shape ?? 0,
    D,
    ribs: ribList,
    normal,
    scale,
    alpha,
    sigma,
    sigmaEff,
    dBox,
    shadeTable,
    region
  };
}

// The colors' discs: the base, then twelve soft discs riding ellipses along the ribs.
function field(geometry, colors) {
  const { width: W, height: H, D } = geometry;
  const rand = dice(geometry.shape ? seedOf(geometry.shape) : T.seed);
  const rows = Math.ceil(T.nPts / T.gridX);
  const discs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < T.nPts; i++) {
    const gx = ((i % T.gridX) + 0.5) / T.gridX;
    const gy = (Math.floor(i / T.gridX) + 0.5) / rows;
    const bx = (gx - 0.5) * W * T.spread + (rand() - 0.5) * W * T.jitter;
    const by = (gy - 0.5) * H * T.spread + (rand() - 0.5) * H * T.jitter;
    const laps = (rand() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2) * (rand() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
    const th0 = rand();
    rand();
    const a = r2(Math.max(0.5, T.orbitAlong * D * (0.7 + 0.6 * rand())));
    const b = r2(Math.max(0.5, T.orbitAcross * D * (0.7 + 0.6 * rand())));
    const R = r2(T.sigma * D * (0.85 + 0.3 * rand()) * T.discScale);
    const dur = r3(LOOP / Math.abs(laps));
    const delay = r3(-th0 * dur);
    discs.push({
      cx: r2(W / 2 + bx),
      cy: r2(H / 2 + by),
      a,
      b,
      R,
      dur,
      delay,
      dir: laps > 0 ? 1 : -1,
      color: colors[i % colors.length]
    });
  }
  return { base: colors[T.base % colors.length], core: r4(T.core), discs };
}

// A disc's middle at t, seconds of the loop at speed 1, into out[k] and out[k + 1].
function discAt(geometry, d, t, out, k) {
  const ang = (d.dir * 2 * Math.PI * (t - d.delay)) / d.dur;
  const al = (geometry.alpha * Math.PI) / 180;
  const ex = d.a * Math.cos(ang);
  const ey = d.b * Math.sin(ang);
  out[k] = d.cx + ex * Math.cos(al) - ey * Math.sin(al);
  out[k + 1] = d.cy + ex * Math.sin(al) + ey * Math.cos(al);
}

// The one design scaled to cover a canvas of w by h device pixels, and the part of it the canvas shows.
function cover(width, height, angle, shape) {
  const k = Math.max(width / DESIGN, height / DESIGN);
  const g = geometry(
    Math.max(1, Math.round(DESIGN * k)),
    Math.max(1, Math.round(DESIGN * k)),
    angle,
    shape
  );
  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(width));
  const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(height));
  return { geometry: g, window: { x: Math.round((g.width - w) / 2), y: Math.round((g.height - h) / 2), w, h } };
}

// The field's texture: 1/q of the region, q set so the blur spans about three texels, and its blur as a Gaussian of
// the three boxes' variance, eleven taps a pass (the middle and five bilinear pairs either side).
function plan(geometry) {
  const q = Math.max(1, geometry.sigmaEff / 3);
  const fw = Math.ceil(geometry.region.w / q) + 1;
  const fh = Math.ceil(geometry.region.h / q) + 1;
  const s = geometry.sigmaEff / q;
  const w = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) w.push(Math.exp(-(i * i) / (2 * s * s)));
  const tot = w[0] + 2 * w.slice(1).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const taps = [[0, w[0] / tot]];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 9; i += 2) {
    const a = w[i] / tot;
    const b = w[i + 1] / tot;
    taps.push([i + b / (a + b), a + b]);
  }
  return { q, fw, fh, s, taps };
}

const hexRgb = hex => {
  const n = Number.parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
  return [((n >> 16) & 255) / 255, ((n >> 8) & 255) / 255, (n & 255) / 255];
};

// The player's drawing in WebGPU: the same textures, laid out as the player's, the same passes and the same numbers. A
// device the browser loses is asked for again, and the new one gets a drawing of its own.
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const context = canvas.getContext("webgpu");
const gpu = async () => {
  const adapter = await navigator.gpu?.requestAdapter().catch(() => null);
  return (await adapter?.requestDevice().catch(() => null)) ?? null;
};
const device = await gpu();
if (device) play(device);
else document.body.textContent = "This page needs WebGPU, which this browser does not have.";

function drawing(device) {
  const format = navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat();
  context.configure({ device, format, alphaMode: "opaque" });
  const module = id => device.createShaderModule({ code: document.getElementById(id).textContent });
  // Two triangles over a target, and the discs as instances of them: middle, radius and core, then color.
  const QUAD = [{ arrayStride: 8, attributes: [{ shaderLocation: 0, offset: 0, format: "float32x2" }] }];
  const pipeline = (id, target, buffers, blend) => {
    const code = module(id);
    return device.createRenderPipeline({
      layout: "auto",
      vertex: { module: code, entryPoint: "vs_main", buffers },
      fragment: { module: code, entryPoint: "fs_main", targets: [{ format: target, blend }] },
      primitive: { topology: "triangle-strip" }
    });
  };
  const over = { srcFactor: "one", dstFactor: "one-minus-src-alpha", operation: "add" };
  const pDisc = pipeline(
    "disc",
    "rgba8unorm",
    [
      ...QUAD,
      {
        arrayStride: 28,
        stepMode: "instance",
        attributes: [
          { shaderLocation: 1, offset: 0, format: "float32x4" },
          { shaderLocation: 2, offset: 16, format: "float32x3" }
        ]
      }
    ],
    { color: over, alpha: over }
  );
  const pBlur = pipeline("blur", "rgba8unorm", QUAD);
  const pFinal = pipeline("glass", format, QUAD);
  const pBake = pipeline("bake", "rgba8unorm", QUAD);
  const buffer = (size, usage) => device.createBuffer({ size, usage: usage | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST });
  const quad = buffer(32, GPUBufferUsage.VERTEX);
  device.queue.writeBuffer(quad, 0, new Float32Array([-1, -1, 1, -1, -1, 1, 1, 1]));
  const uField = buffer(16, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const uAcross = buffer(112, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const uDown = buffer(112, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const uGlass = buffer(32, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const uBake = buffer(576, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const bilinear = device.createSampler({ magFilter: "linear", minFilter: "linear" });
  const target = (w, h) =>
    device.createTexture({
      size: [w, h],
      format: "rgba8unorm",
      usage: GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT | GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING
    });
  const group = (p, entries) =>
    device.createBindGroup({
      layout: p.getBindGroupLayout(0),
      entries: entries.map((resource, binding) => ({ binding, resource }))
    });

  let geo = null;
  let win = null;
  let pl = null;
  let fld = null;
  let stale = false;
  let data = new Float32Array(0);
  let inst = null;
  const pos = new Float32Array(2);
  let base = [0, 0, 0];
  let mapTex = null;
  let fieldTex = [];
  let groups = null;

  // The colors' discs for the layout.
  const color = () => {
    fld = field(geo, COLORS);
    if (data.length !== 7 * fld.discs.length) {
      data = new Float32Array(7 * fld.discs.length);
      inst?.destroy();
      inst = buffer(data.byteLength, GPUBufferUsage.VERTEX);
    }
    fld.discs.forEach((d, i) => {
      const c = hexRgb(d.color);
      data[7 * i + 2] = d.R / pl.q;
      data[7 * i + 3] = fld.core;
      data[7 * i + 4] = c[0];
      data[7 * i + 5] = c[1];
      data[7 * i + 6] = c[2];
    });
    base = hexRgb(fld.base);
  };

  // The design covering the canvas, the textures its size, and the rib map baked with the next frame.
  const layout = (w, h) => {
    const next = cover(w, h, ANGLE, SHAPE);
    if (
      geo &&
      geo.width === next.geometry.width &&
      geo.angle === next.geometry.angle &&
      geo.shape === next.geometry.shape &&
      win.w === next.window.w &&
      win.h === next.window.h
    )
      return;

  const k1 = Math.ceil(Math.max(...edgeK)) + 1;
  const N = T.lensStops;
  const seamPx = Math.max(T.seamW * u, 1.2);
  const raw = [];
  let dmax = 1;
  for (let k = k0; k < k1; k++) {
    const sIn = sOf(k);
    const sOut = sOf(k + 1);
    const cx = W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + sOut * g.arcDir[0]) * D;
    const cy = H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + sOut * g.arcDir[1]) * D;
    const R = (g.arcR0 + g.arcG * sOut) * D;
    const pitch = (sOut - sIn) * (1 + g.arcG) * D;
    const seam = seamPx / pitch;
    const stops = [];
    for (let j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
      const x = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos((Math.PI * j) / N);
      const e = Math.abs(x - 0.5) - 0.5;
      const tt = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e + seam) / (2 * seam)));
      const band = tt * tt * (3 - 2 * tt);
      const uf = x * (1 - band) + (1 - x) * band;
      const d = lensF(2 * uf - 1) * pitch * T.disp;
      dmax = Math.max(dmax, Math.abs(d));
      stops.push([(R - pitch + x * pitch) / R, d]);
    }
    raw.push({ cx, cy, R, stops });
  }
  dmax *= 1.02;
  const scale = r2(2 * dmax);
  const ribList = raw.map(r => ({
    cx: r2(r.cx),
    cy: r2(r.cy),
    r: r2(r.R),
    stops: r.stops.map(([o, d]) => [
      r4(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, o))),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * d) / (scale / 2)))
    ])
  }));
  const sMid = levelAt(W / 2, H / 2);
  const cm = [
    W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + sMid * g.arcDir[0]) * D,
    H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + sMid * g.arcDir[1]) * D
  ];
  const nl = Math.hypot(W / 2 - cm[0], H / 2 - cm[1]);
  const n0 = [(W / 2 - cm[0]) / nl, (H / 2 - cm[1]) / nl];
  const t0 = [-n0[1], n0[0]];
  const L = Math.abs(W * t0[0]) + Math.abs(H * t0[1]);
  const nStops = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= 16; j++) {
    const x = -L / 2 + (L * j) / 16;
    const X = W / 2 + t0[0] * x;
    const Y = H / 2 + t0[1] * x;
    const s = levelAt(X, Y);
    const c = [
      W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + s * g.arcDir[0]) * D,
      H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + s * g.arcDir[1]) * D
    ];
    const l = Math.hypot(X - c[0], Y - c[1]);
    nStops.push([
      r4(j / 16),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * (X - c[0])) / l)),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * (Y - c[1])) / l))
    ]);
  }
  const normal = {
    x1: r2(W / 2 - (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y1: r2(H / 2 - (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    x2: r2(W / 2 + (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y2: r2(H / 2 + (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    stops: nStops
  };
  const alpha = alphaOf(angle, shape);
  const sigma = r2(T.blur * u);
  const dBox = Math.floor((sigma * 3 * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)) / 4 + 0.5);
  const sigmaEff = Math.sqrt(
    dBox % 2 ? (dBox * dBox - 1) / 4 : (3 * dBox * dBox + 2 * dBox - 2) / 12
  );
  const shadeTable = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => {
    const x = (2 * i) / 16 - 1;
    return r4(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 0.5 * (1 + T.shade * (T.shadeSkew * x - x * x + 1 / 3)))));
  });
  const move = Math.ceil(scale / 2) + 1;
  const reach = Math.ceil(1.5 * dBox) + 1;
  const region = {
    x: -move - reach,
    y: -move - reach,
    w: W + 2 * (move + reach),
    h: H + 2 * (move + reach)
  };
  return {
    width: W,
    height: H,
    angle,
    shape: shape ?? 0,
    D,
    ribs: ribList,
    normal,
    scale,
    alpha,
    sigma,
    sigmaEff,
    dBox,
    shadeTable,
    region
  };
}

// The colors' discs: the base, then twelve soft discs riding ellipses along the ribs.
function field(geometry, colors) {
  const { width: W, height: H, D } = geometry;
  const rand = dice(geometry.shape ? seedOf(geometry.shape) : T.seed);
  const rows = Math.ceil(T.nPts / T.gridX);
  const discs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < T.nPts; i++) {
    const gx = ((i % T.gridX) + 0.5) / T.gridX;
    const gy = (Math.floor(i / T.gridX) + 0.5) / rows;
    const bx = (gx - 0.5) * W * T.spread + (rand() - 0.5) * W * T.jitter;
    const by = (gy - 0.5) * H * T.spread + (rand() - 0.5) * H * T.jitter;
    const laps = (rand() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2) * (rand() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
    const th0 = rand();
    rand();
    const a = r2(Math.max(0.5, T.orbitAlong * D * (0.7 + 0.6 * rand())));
    const b = r2(Math.max(0.5, T.orbitAcross * D * (0.7 + 0.6 * rand())));
    const R = r2(T.sigma * D * (0.85 + 0.3 * rand()) * T.discScale);
    const dur = r3(LOOP / Math.abs(laps));
    const delay = r3(-th0 * dur);
    discs.push({
      cx: r2(W / 2 + bx),
      cy: r2(H / 2 + by),
      a,
      b,
      R,
      dur,
      delay,
      dir: laps > 0 ? 1 : -1,
      color: colors[i % colors.length]
    });
  }
  return { base: colors[T.base % colors.length], core: r4(T.core), discs };
}

// A disc's middle at t, seconds of the loop at speed 1, into out[k] and out[k + 1].
function discAt(geometry, d, t, out, k) {
  const ang = (d.dir * 2 * Math.PI * (t - d.delay)) / d.dur;
  const al = (geometry.alpha * Math.PI) / 180;
  const ex = d.a * Math.cos(ang);
  const ey = d.b * Math.sin(ang);
  out[k] = d.cx + ex * Math.cos(al) - ey * Math.sin(al);
  out[k + 1] = d.cy + ex * Math.sin(al) + ey * Math.cos(al);
}

// The one design scaled to cover a canvas of w by h device pixels, and the part of it the canvas shows.
function cover(width, height, angle, shape) {
  const k = Math.max(width / DESIGN, height / DESIGN);
  const g = geometry(
    Math.max(1, Math.round(DESIGN * k)),
    Math.max(1, Math.round(DESIGN * k)),
    angle,
    shape
  );
  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(width));
  const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(height));
  return { geometry: g, window: { x: Math.round((g.width - w) / 2), y: Math.round((g.height - h) / 2), w, h } };
}

// The field's texture: 1/q of the region, q set so the blur spans about three texels, and its blur as a Gaussian of
// the three boxes' variance, eleven taps a pass (the middle and five bilinear pairs either side).
function plan(geometry) {
  const q = Math.max(1, geometry.sigmaEff / 3);
  const fw = Math.ceil(geometry.region.w / q) + 1;
  const fh = Math.ceil(geometry.region.h / q) + 1;
  const s = geometry.sigmaEff / q;
  const w = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) w.push(Math.exp(-(i * i) / (2 * s * s)));
  const tot = w[0] + 2 * w.slice(1).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const taps = [[0, w[0] / tot]];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 9; i += 2) {
    const a = w[i] / tot;
    const b = w[i + 1] / tot;
    taps.push([i + b / (a + b), a + b]);
  }
  return { q, fw, fh, s, taps };
}

const hexRgb = hex => {
  const n = Number.parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
  return [((n >> 16) & 255) / 255, ((n >> 8) & 255) / 255, (n & 255) / 255];
};

// The player's drawing: the same textures, passes and uniforms, so each frame's GPU work is the player's. A context the
// browser gives back after losing it gets a drawing of its own.
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl2", {
  alpha: false,
  antialias: false,
  depth: false,
  stencil: false,
  premultipliedAlpha: true,
  preserveDrawingBuffer: false
});
if (gl) play();
else document.body.textContent = "This page needs WebGL 2, which this browser does not have.";

function drawing() {
  const compile = (type, id) => {
    const shader = gl.createShader(type);
    gl.shaderSource(shader, document.getElementById(id).textContent);
    gl.compileShader(shader);
    if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) throw new Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader));
    return shader;
  };
  const link = (vertex, fragment) => {
    const program = gl.createProgram();
    gl.attachShader(program, vertex);
    gl.attachShader(program, fragment);
    gl.linkProgram(program);
    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) throw new Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(program));
    return program;
  };
  const full = compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, "full-vs");
  const pDisc = link(compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, "disc-vs"), compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, "disc-fs"));
  const pBlur = link(full, compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, "blur-fs"));
  const pFinal = link(full, compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, "final-fs"));
  const pBake = link(full, compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, "bake-fs"));
  const at = (program, name) => gl.getUniformLocation(program, name);
  const U = {
    dField: at(pDisc, "uField"),
    bSrc: at(pBlur, "uSrc"),
    bStep: at(pBlur, "uStep"),
    bTaps: at(pBlur, "uTaps"),
    fMap: at(pFinal, "uMap"),
    fField: at(pFinal, "uFieldT"),
    fH: at(pFinal, "uH"),
    fOrigin: at(pFinal, "uOrigin"),
    fOffset: at(pFinal, "uOffset"),
    fInv: at(pFinal, "uInv"),
    fScale: at(pFinal, "uScale"),
    kRibs: at(pBake, "uRibs"),
    kCount: at(pBake, "uCount"),
    kStops: at(pBake, "uStops"),
    kOrigin: at(pBake, "uOrigin"),
    kLine: at(pBake, "uLine"),
    kNormals: at(pBake, "uNormals"),
    kShade: at(pBake, "uShade")
  };
  // Two triangles over a target, and the discs as instances of them: middle, radius and core, then color.
  const quad = gl.createBuffer();
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, quad);
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1, -1, 1, -1, -1, 1, 1, 1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  const inst = gl.createBuffer();
  const discVao = gl.createVertexArray();
  gl.bindVertexArray(discVao);
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, quad);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, inst);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 28, 0);
  gl.vertexAttribDivisor(1, 1);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(2);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(2, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 28, 16);
  gl.vertexAttribDivisor(2, 1);
  const fullVao = gl.createVertexArray();
  gl.bindVertexArray(fullVao);
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, quad);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
  gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  gl.bindVertexArray(null);
  const texture = filter => {
    const t = gl.createTexture();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    return t;
  };
  // The rib map (the window's size), the ribs and their stops a row each, and the field and its blur.
  const mapTex = texture(gl.NEAREST);
  const ribsTex = texture(gl.NEAREST);
  const bakeFbo = gl.createFramebuffer();
  const fieldTex = [texture(gl.LINEAR), texture(gl.LINEAR)];
  const fbo = [gl.createFramebuffer(), gl.createFramebuffer()];

  let geo = null;
  let win = null;
  let pl = null;
  let fld = null;
  let stale = false;
  let data = new Float32Array(0);
  const pos = new Float32Array(2);
  const taps = new Float32Array(12);
  let base = [0, 0, 0];

  // The colors' discs for the layout.
  const color = () => {
    fld = field(geo, COLORS);
    if (data.length !== 7 * fld.discs.length) {
      data = new Float32Array(7 * fld.discs.length);
      gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, inst);
      gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, data.byteLength, gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
    }
    fld.discs.forEach((d, i) => {
      const c = hexRgb(d.color);
      data[7 * i + 2] = d.R / pl.q;
      data[7 * i + 3] = fld.core;
      data[7 * i + 4] = c[0];
      data[7 * i + 5] = c[1];
      data[7 * i + 6] = c[2];
    });
    base = hexRgb(fld.base);
  };

  // The design covering the canvas, the textures its size, and the rib map baked with the next frame.
  const layout = (w, h) => {
    const next = cover(w, h, ANGLE, SHAPE);
    if (
      geo &&
      geo.width === next.geometry.width &&
      geo.angle === next.geometry.angle &&
      geo.shape === next.geometry.shape &&
      win.w === next.window.w &&
      win.h === next.window.h
    )
      return;
    const resized = !win || win.w !== next.window.w || win.h !== next.window.h;
    const was = pl;
    geo = next.geometry;
    win = next.window;
    pl = plan(geo);
    if (resized) {
      gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, mapTex);
      gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA8, win.w, win.h, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null);
    }
    stale = true;
    if (resized || !was || was.fw !== pl.fw || was.fh !== pl.fh) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, fieldTex[i]);
        gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA8, pl.fw, pl.fh, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null);
        gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo[i]);
        gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, fieldTex[i], 0);
      }
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
      taps.fill(0);
      pl.taps.forEach(([o, w], i) => {
        taps[2 * i] = o;
        taps[2 * i + 1] = w;
      });
    }
    color();
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
  };

  // The rib map: each pixel's displacement and light, in one pass.
  const normals = new Float32Array(17 * 3);
  const shade = new Float32Array(17);
  const bake = () => {
    const list = geo.ribs;
    const stops = list[0]?.stops.length ?? 0;
    const width = 1 + stops;
    const rows = new Float32Array(width * list.length * 4);
    list.forEach((r, i) => {
      const row = i * width * 4;
      rows[row] = r.cx;
      rows[row + 1] = r.cy;
      rows[row + 2] = r.r * r.r;
      r.stops.forEach(([o, v], k) => {
        rows[row + 4 * (1 + k)] = o;
        rows[row + 4 * (1 + k) + 1] = v;
      });
    });
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, ribsTex);
    gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 4);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA32F, width, Math.max(1, list.length), 0, gl.RGBA, gl.FLOAT, rows);
    geo.normal.stops.forEach(([o, r, g], k) => {
      normals[3 * k] = o;
      normals[3 * k + 1] = r;
      normals[3 * k + 2] = g;
    });
    geo.shadeTable.forEach((v, k) => {
      shade[k] = v;
    });
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, bakeFbo);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, mapTex, 0);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, win.w, win.h);
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.useProgram(pBake);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, ribsTex);
    gl.uniform1i(U.kRibs, 0);
    gl.uniform1i(U.kCount, list.length);
    gl.uniform1i(U.kStops, stops);
    gl.uniform2f(U.kOrigin, win.x, win.y);
    const n = geo.normal;
    gl.uniform4f(U.kLine, n.x1, n.y1, n.x2 - n.x1, n.y2 - n.y1);
    gl.uniform3fv(U.kNormals, normals);
    gl.uniform1fv(U.kShade, shade);
    gl.bindVertexArray(fullVao);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    gl.bindVertexArray(null);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
  };

  // A frame: the discs into the field, the blur across and down, and the glass over the canvas.
  const draw = t => {
    if (stale) {
      bake();
      stale = false;
    }
    const { region } = geo;
    const q = pl.q;
    for (let i = 0; i < fld.discs.length; i++) {
      discAt(geo, fld.discs[i], t, pos, 0);
      data[7 * i] = (pos[0] - region.x) / q;
      data[7 * i + 1] = (pos[1] - region.y) / q;
    }
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, inst);
    gl.bufferSubData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, data);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo[0]);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, pl.fw, pl.fh);
    gl.clearColor(base[0], base[1], base[2], 1);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
    gl.useProgram(pDisc);
    gl.uniform2f(U.dField, pl.fw, pl.fh);
    gl.bindVertexArray(discVao);
    gl.drawArraysInstanced(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4, fld.discs.length);
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.useProgram(pBlur);
    gl.bindVertexArray(fullVao);
    gl.uniform2fv(U.bTaps, taps);
    gl.uniform1i(U.bSrc, 0);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo[1]);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, fieldTex[0]);
    gl.uniform2f(U.bStep, 1 / pl.fw, 0);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo[0]);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, fieldTex[1]);
    gl.uniform2f(U.bStep, 0, 1 / pl.fh);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, win.w, win.h);
    gl.useProgram(pFinal);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, mapTex);
    gl.uniform1i(U.fMap, 0);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, fieldTex[0]);
    gl.uniform1i(U.fField, 1);
    gl.uniform1f(U.fH, win.h);
    gl.uniform2f(U.fOrigin, region.x, region.y);
    gl.uniform2f(U.fOffset, win.x, win.y);
    gl.uniform2f(U.fInv, 1 / (q * pl.fw), 1 / (q * pl.fh));
    gl.uniform1f(U.fScale, geo.scale);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
  };
  return { layout, draw };
}

function play() {
  let drawn = drawing();
  const layout = (w, h) => drawn?.layout(w, h);
  const draw = t => drawn?.draw(t);
  // The canvas's size in device pixels as the browser lays it out, up to a 4K screen's pixels, as the player sizes it.
  const PIXELS_MAX = 8300000;
  let pixels = null;
  let laidOut = false;
  const resize = () => {
    const dpr = devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const css = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!css.width || !css.height) return;
    const ew = Math.round(css.width * dpr);
    const eh = Math.round(css.height * dpr);
    const exact = pixels && Math.abs(pixels.w - ew) <= 2 && Math.abs(pixels.h - eh) <= 2;
    const w0 = exact ? pixels.w : ew;
    const h0 = exact ? pixels.h : eh;
    const fit = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(PIXELS_MAX / Math.max(1, w0 * h0)));
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w0 * fit));
    const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h0 * fit));
    layout(w, h);
    laidOut = true;
  };

  // The clock: seconds of the loop at speed 1, advanced by SPEED, so the motion eases in from rest over EASE seconds once
  // the first frame is drawn. A frame is drawn when the picture changed or one is due at FPS; a reader who asks for
  // less motion sees the first frame.
  const reduced = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  let lost = false;
  const playing = () => !document.hidden && !reduced.matches && !lost;
  let t = 0;
  let warm = 0;
  let last = performance.now();
  let lastDrawn = -1;
  let changed = true;
  let first = true;
  let raf = 0;
  let settle = 0;
  // A frame is due once each 1/FPS, a little early rather than a refresh late, counted from the last one's due time.
  let paced = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  const due = now => {
    if (!FPS) return true;
    const every = 1000 / FPS;
    if (now - paced < every - Math.min(4, every * 0.2)) return false;
    paced = now - paced > 2 * every ? now : paced + every;
    return true;
  };
  const tick = now => {
    raf = 0;
    if (lost) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    if (!playing() || SPEED === 0) warm = 0;
    else if (laidOut && !first) {
      warm = Math.min(EASE, warm + dt);
      const e = EASE ? warm / EASE : 1;
      t += dt * SPEED * e * e * (3 - 2 * e);
    }
    if (laidOut) {
      const at = reduced.matches ? 0 : t;
      if (changed || (at !== lastDrawn && due(now))) {
        draw(at);
        lastDrawn = at;
        changed = false;
        first = false;
      }
    }
    if (playing() && SPEED > 0) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  const wake = () => {
    last = performance.now();

      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * (Y - c[1])) / l))

  const normal = {
    x1: r2(W / 2 - (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y1: r2(H / 2 - (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    x2: r2(W / 2 + (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y2: r2(H / 2 + (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    stops: nStops
  };
  const alpha = alphaOf(angle, shape);
  const sigma = r2(T.blur * u);
  const dBox = Math.floor((sigma * 3 * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)) / 4 + 0.5);
  const sigmaEff = Math.sqrt(
    dBox % 2 ? (dBox * dBox - 1) / 4 : (3 * dBox * dBox + 2 * dBox - 2) / 12
  );
  const shadeTable = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => {
    const x = (2 * i) / 16 - 1;
    return r4(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 0.5 * (1 + T.shade * (T.shadeSkew * x - x * x + 1 / 3)))));
  });

  const reach = Math.ceil(1.5 * dBox) + 1;
  const region = {
    x: -move - reach,
    y: -move - reach,
    w: W + 2 * (move + reach),
    h: H + 2 * (move + reach)
  };
  return {
    width: W,
    height: H,
    angle,
    shape: shape ?? 0,
    D,
    ribs: ribList,
    normal,
    scale,
    alpha,
    sigma,
    sigmaEff,
    dBox,
    shadeTable,
    region

}

// The colors' discs: the base, then twelve soft discs riding ellipses along the ribs.
function field(geometry, colors) {
  const { width: W, height: H, D } = geometry;
  const rand = dice(geometry.shape ? seedOf(geometry.shape) : T.seed);
  const rows = Math.ceil(T.nPts / T.gridX);
  const discs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < T.nPts; i++) {
    const gx = ((i % T.gridX) + 0.5) / T.gridX;
    const gy = (Math.floor(i / T.gridX) + 0.5) / rows;
    const bx = (gx - 0.5) * W * T.spread + (rand() - 0.5) * W * T.jitter;
    const by = (gy - 0.5) * H * T.spread + (rand() - 0.5) * H * T.jitter;
    const laps = (rand() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2) * (rand() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
    const th0 = rand();
    rand();
    const a = r2(Math.max(0.5, T.orbitAlong * D * (0.7 + 0.6 * rand())));
    const b = r2(Math.max(0.5, T.orbitAcross * D * (0.7 + 0.6 * rand())));
    const R = r2(T.sigma * D * (0.85 + 0.3 * rand()) * T.discScale);
    const dur = r3(LOOP / Math.abs(laps));
    const delay = r3(-th0 * dur);
    discs.push({
      cx: r2(W / 2 + bx),
      cy: r2(H / 2 + by),
      a,
      b,
      R,
      dur,
      delay,
      dir: laps > 0 ? 1 : -1,
      color: colors[i % colors.length]
    });
  }
  return { base: colors[T.base % colors.length], core: r4(T.core), discs };
}

// A disc's middle at t, seconds of the loop at speed 1, into out[k] and out[k + 1].
function discAt(geometry, d, t, out, k) {
  const ang = (d.dir * 2 * Math.PI * (t - d.delay)) / d.dur;
  const al = (geometry.alpha * Math.PI) / 180;
  const ex = d.a * Math.cos(ang);
  const ey = d.b * Math.sin(ang);
  out[k] = d.cx + ex * Math.cos(al) - ey * Math.sin(al);
  out[k + 1] = d.cy + ex * Math.sin(al) + ey * Math.cos(al);
}

// The one design scaled to cover a canvas of w by h device pixels, and the part of it the canvas shows.
function cover(width, height, angle, shape) {
  const k = Math.max(width / DESIGN, height / DESIGN);
  const g = geometry(
    Math.max(1, Math.round(DESIGN * k)),
    Math.max(1, Math.round(DESIGN * k)),
    angle,
    shape
  );
  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(width));
  const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(height));
  return { geometry: g, window: { x: Math.round((g.width - w) / 2), y: Math.round((g.height - h) / 2), w, h } };
}

// The field's texture: 1/q of the region, q set so the blur spans about three texels, and its blur as a Gaussian of
// the three boxes' variance, eleven taps a pass (the middle and five bilinear pairs either side).
function plan(geometry) {
  const q = Math.max(1, geometry.sigmaEff / 3);
  const fw = Math.ceil(geometry.region.w / q) + 1;
  const fh = Math.ceil(geometry.region.h / q) + 1;
  const s = geometry.sigmaEff / q;
  const w = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) w.push(Math.exp(-(i * i) / (2 * s * s)));
  const tot = w[0] + 2 * w.slice(1).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const taps = [[0, w[0] / tot]];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 9; i += 2) {
    const a = w[i] / tot;
    const b = w[i + 1] / tot;
    taps.push([i + b / (a + b), a + b]);
  }
  return { q, fw, fh, s, taps };
}

const hexRgb = hex => {
  const n = Number.parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
  return [((n >> 16) & 255) / 255, ((n >> 8) & 255) / 255, (n & 255) / 255];
};

// The player's drawing in WebGPU: the same textures, laid out as the player's, the same passes and the same numbers. A
// device the browser loses is asked for again, and the new one gets a drawing of its own.

  // Two triangles over a target, and the discs as instances of them: middle, radius and core, then color.
  const QUAD = [{ arrayStride: 8, attributes: [{ shaderLocation: 0, offset: 0, format: "float32x2" }] }];
  const pipeline = (id, target, buffers, blend) => {
    const code = module(id);
    return device.createRenderPipeline({
      layout: "auto",
      vertex: { module: code, entryPoint: "vs_main", buffers },
      fragment: { module: code, entryPoint: "fs_main", targets: [{ format: target, blend }] },
      primitive: { topology: "triangle-strip" }
    });

  const over = { srcFactor: "one", dstFactor: "one-minus-src-alpha", operation: "add" };
  const pDisc = pipeline(
    "disc",
    "rgba8unorm",
    [
      ...QUAD,
      {
        arrayStride: 28,
        stepMode: "instance",
        attributes: [
          { shaderLocation: 1, offset: 0, format: "float32x4" },
          { shaderLocation: 2, offset: 16, format: "float32x3" }

    { color: over, alpha: over }

  const pFinal = pipeline("glass", format, QUAD);
  const pBake = pipeline("bake", "rgba8unorm", QUAD);

  const quad = buffer(32, GPUBufferUsage.VERTEX);
  device.queue.writeBuffer(quad, 0, new Float32Array([-1, -1, 1, -1, -1, 1, 1, 1]));
  const uField = buffer(16, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const uAcross = buffer(112, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const uDown = buffer(112, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const uGlass = buffer(32, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const uBake = buffer(576, GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM);
  const bilinear = device.createSampler({ magFilter: "linear", minFilter: "linear" });
  const target = (w, h) =>
    device.createTexture({
      size: [w, h],
      format: "rgba8unorm",
      usage: GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT | GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING
    });
  const group = (p, entries) =>
    device.createBindGroup({
      layout: p.getBindGroupLayout(0),
      entries: entries.map((resource, binding) => ({ binding, resource }))
    });

  let geo = null;
  let win = null;
  let pl = null;
  let fld = null;
  let stale = false;
  let data = new Float32Array(0);
  let inst = null;
  const pos = new Float32Array(2);
  let base = [0, 0, 0];
  let mapTex = null;
  let fieldTex = [];
  let groups = null;

  // The colors' discs for the layout.
  const color = () => {
    fld = field(geo, COLORS);
    if (data.length !== 7 * fld.discs.length) {
      data = new Float32Array(7 * fld.discs.length);
      inst?.destroy();
      inst = buffer(data.byteLength, GPUBufferUsage.VERTEX);
    }
    fld.discs.forEach((d, i) => {
      const c = hexRgb(d.color);
      data[7 * i + 2] = d.R / pl.q;
      data[7 * i + 3] = fld.core;
      data[7 * i + 4] = c[0];
      data[7 * i + 5] = c[1];
      data[7 * i + 6] = c[2];

  const layout = (w, h) => {
    const next = cover(w, h, ANGLE, SHAPE);
    if (
      geo &&
      geo.width === next.geometry.width &&
      geo.angle === next.geometry.angle &&
      geo.shape === next.geometry.shape &&
      win.w === next.window.w &&
      win.h === next.window.h
    )
      return;
    const resized = !win || win.w !== next.window.w || win.h !== next.window.h;
    const was = pl;
    geo = next.geometry;
    win = next.window;
    pl = plan(geo);
    if (resized) {
      mapTex?.destroy();
      mapTex = target(win.w, win.h);
    }
    stale = true;
    if (resized || !was || was.fw !== pl.fw || was.fh !== pl.fh) {
      for (const t of fieldTex) t.destroy();
      fieldTex = [target(pl.fw, pl.fh), target(pl.fw, pl.fh)];
      const taps = new Float32Array(24);
      pl.taps.forEach(([o, w], i) => {
        taps[4 * i] = o;
        taps[4 * i + 1] = w;
      });
      const blur = (x, y) => {
        const values = new Float32Array(28);
        values[0] = x;
        values[1] = y;
        values.set(taps, 4);
        return values;
      };
      device.queue.writeBuffer(uAcross, 0, blur(1 / pl.fw, 0));
      device.queue.writeBuffer(uDown, 0, blur(0, 1 / pl.fh));
      device.queue.writeBuffer(uField, 0, new Float32Array([pl.fw, pl.fh, 0, 1]));
    }
    color();
    const views = { map: mapTex.createView(), field: fieldTex.map(t => t.createView()) };
    groups = {
      disc: group(pDisc, [{ buffer: uField }]),
      across: group(pBlur, [views.field[0], bilinear, { buffer: uAcross }]),
      down: group(pBlur, [views.field[1], bilinear, { buffer: uDown }]),
      glass: group(pFinal, [views.map, views.field[0], bilinear, { buffer: uGlass }]),
      views
    };
    const { region } = geo;
    device.queue.writeBuffer(
      uGlass,
      0,
      new Float32Array([region.x, region.y, win.x, win.y, 1 / (pl.q * pl.fw), 1 / (pl.q * pl.fh), win.h, geo.scale])
    );
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
  };

  // The rib map: each pixel's displacement and light, in one pass.
  const bake = encoder => {
    const list = geo.ribs;
    const stops = list[0]?.stops.length ?? 0;
    const width = 1 + stops;
    const rows = new Float32Array(Math.max(1, width * list.length) * 4);
    list.forEach((r, i) => {
      const row = i * width * 4;
      rows[row] = r.cx;
      rows[row + 1] = r.cy;
      rows[row + 2] = r.r * r.r;
      r.stops.forEach(([o, v], k) => {
        rows[row + 4 * (1 + k)] = o;
        rows[row + 4 * (1 + k) + 1] = v;
      });
    });
    const ribsBuffer = buffer(rows.byteLength, GPUBufferUsage.STORAGE);
    device.queue.writeBuffer(ribsBuffer, 0, rows);
    const values = new ArrayBuffer(576);
    const f = new Float32Array(values);
    const n = geo.normal;
    f.set([win.x, win.y], 0);
    new Int32Array(values, 8, 2).set([list.length, stops]);
    f.set([n.x1, n.y1, n.x2 - n.x1, n.y2 - n.y1], 4);
    n.stops.forEach(([o, r, g], k) => f.set([o, r, g], 8 + 4 * k));
    geo.shadeTable.forEach((v, k) => {
      f[76 + 4 * k] = v;
    });
    device.queue.writeBuffer(uBake, 0, values);
    const pass = encoder.beginRenderPass({
      colorAttachments: [{ view: groups.views.map, loadOp: "clear", storeOp: "store" }]
    });
    pass.setPipeline(pBake);
    pass.setBindGroup(0, group(pBake, [{ buffer: ribsBuffer }, { buffer: uBake }]));
    pass.setVertexBuffer(0, quad);
    pass.draw(4);
    pass.end();
    return ribsBuffer;
  };

  const run = (encoder, view, p, bindGroup, load) => {
    const pass = encoder.beginRenderPass({
      colorAttachments: [{ view, loadOp: "clear", clearValue: load, storeOp: "store" }]
    });
    pass.setPipeline(p);
    pass.setBindGroup(0, bindGroup);
    pass.setVertexBuffer(0, quad);
    return pass;
  };

  // A frame: the discs into the field, the blur across and down, and the glass over the canvas.
  const draw = t => {
    const encoder = device.createCommandEncoder();
    const ribsBuffer = stale ? bake(encoder) : null;
    stale = false;
    const { region } = geo;
    const q = pl.q;
    for (let i = 0; i < fld.discs.length; i++) {
      discAt(geo, fld.discs[i], t, pos, 0);
      data[7 * i] = (pos[0] - region.x) / q;
      data[7 * i + 1] = (pos[1] - region.y) / q;
    }
    device.queue.writeBuffer(inst, 0, data);
    const discs = run(encoder, groups.views.field[0], pDisc, groups.disc, { r: base[0], g: base[1], b: base[2], a: 1 });
    discs.setVertexBuffer(1, inst);
    discs.draw(4, fld.discs.length);
    discs.end();
    let pass = run(encoder, groups.views.field[1], pBlur, groups.across);
    pass.draw(4);
    pass.end();
    pass = run(encoder, groups.views.field[0], pBlur, groups.down);
    pass.draw(4);
    pass.end();
    pass = run(encoder, context.getCurrentTexture().createView(), pFinal, groups.glass);
    pass.draw(4);
    pass.end();
    device.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
    ribsBuffer?.destroy();
  };
  return { layout, draw };
}

function play(device) {
  let drawn = drawing(device);
  const layout = (w, h) => drawn?.layout(w, h);
  const draw = t => drawn?.draw(t);
  // The canvas's size in device pixels as the browser lays it out, up to a 4K screen's pixels, as the player sizes it.
  const PIXELS_MAX = 8300000;
  let pixels = null;
  let laidOut = false;

    const dpr = devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const css = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!css.width || !css.height) return;

    const eh = Math.round(css.height * dpr);
    const exact = pixels && Math.abs(pixels.w - ew) <= 2 && Math.abs(pixels.h - eh) <= 2;
    const w0 = exact ? pixels.w : ew;
    const h0 = exact ? pixels.h : eh;
    const fit = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(PIXELS_MAX / Math.max(1, w0 * h0)));
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w0 * fit));
    const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h0 * fit));
    layout(w, h);
    laidOut = true;

  // the first frame is drawn. A frame is drawn when the picture changed or one is due at FPS; a reader who asks for
  // less motion sees the first frame.

  let lost = false;
  const playing = () => !document.hidden && !reduced.matches && !lost;
  let t = 0;
  let warm = 0;
  let last = performance.now();
  let lastDrawn = -1;
  let changed = true;
  let first = true;
  let raf = 0;
  let settle = 0;
  // A frame is due once each 1/FPS, a little early rather than a refresh late, counted from the last one's due time.
  let paced = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  const due = now => {
    if (!FPS) return true;
    const every = 1000 / FPS;
    if (now - paced < every - Math.min(4, every * 0.2)) return false;
    paced = now - paced > 2 * every ? now : paced + every;
    return true;
  };
  const tick = now => {
    raf = 0;
    if (lost) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    if (!playing() || SPEED === 0) warm = 0;
    else if (laidOut && !first) {
      warm = Math.min(EASE, warm + dt);
      const e = EASE ? warm / EASE : 1;
      t += dt * SPEED * e * e * (3 - 2 * e);
    }
    if (laidOut) {
      const at = reduced.matches ? 0 : t;
      if (changed || (at !== lastDrawn && due(now))) {
        draw(at);
        lastDrawn = at;
        changed = false;
        first = false;
      }
    }
    if (playing() && SPEED > 0) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  const wake = () => {
    last = performance.now();
    if (!raf && !lost) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  // The first size comes before the first paint; a later one settles a moment before the drawing is laid out again.
  const sizes = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    const box = entries[entries.length - 1]?.devicePixelContentBoxSize?.[0];
    pixels = box ? { w: box.inlineSize, h: box.blockSize } : null;
    clearTimeout(settle);
    settle = setTimeout(
      () => {
        resize();
        changed = true;
        wake();
      },
      laidOut ? 150 : 0
    );
  });
  try {
    sizes.observe(canvas, { box: "device-pixel-content-box" });
  } catch {
    sizes.observe(canvas);
  }
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (!document.hidden) wake();
  });
  reduced.addEventListener("change", () => {
    changed = true;
    wake();
  });
  // A GPU lost draws nothing, and the loop stops until a new drawing is made on the one found again, which is laid out
  // and drawn at once, the clock going on from where it was.
  const lose = () => {
    lost = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = 0;
  };
  const found = () => {
    lost = false;
    laidOut = false;
    resize();
    changed = true;
    wake();
  };
  // A device lost draws nothing: the page asks for another, three times at most, and goes on with it, or says so.
  let again = 0;
  const watch = one =>
    one.lost.then(async () => {
      lose();
      drawn = null;
      const next = ++again <= 3 ? await gpu() : null;
      if (!next) {
        document.body.textContent = "This page lost its GPU device, and the browser gave it no other.";
        return;
      }
      drawn = drawing(next);
      watch(next);
      found();
    });
  watch(device);
}

<script>
// The design, as the site draws it: the hill climb's numbers. Lengths are in the box's diagonal, or in pixels at
// the reference's 720 by 900 (diagonal REF_D), scaled to the box.
const T = {
  seed: 7,
  geo: { arcC: [-0.6939, -0.6395], arcDir: [0.72384, 0.68997], arcR0: 0.74155, arcG: 0.73876, s0: 0.088544, p0: 0.016224, betaP: 0.18037, betaM: 0.13328, phase: 6.2201 },
  lensA: 1.8221723373606658,
  lensB: 1.3527826156950404,
  lensE: 0.6739178404790045,
  lensKappa: 0.97,
  lensShift: 0.15084155110105363,
  seamW: 13.089314648014595,
  disp: 0.8615750162531419,
  nPts: 12,
  gridX: 4,
  spread: 1.1750951232721354,
  jitter: 0.12508013085004963,
  sigma: 0.10825287299504333,
  orbitAlong: 0.1979667332590454,
  orbitAcross: 0.03473221296011865,
  discScale: 2.3983953901883925,
  core: 0.3626018216611724,
  blur: 28.823670270874572,
  base: 1,
  lensStops: 28,
  shade: 0.058023170773981086,
  shadeSkew: 0.3
};
const REF_D = 1152.56;
const DESIGN = 1000;
const LOOP = 56;
const DESIGN_ANGLE = 90;
const r2 = v => Math.round(v * 100) / 100;
const r3 = v => Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000;
const r4 = v => Math.round(v * 10000) / 10000;

// mulberry32: the design's random numbers, the same everywhere.
function dice(seed) {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
// A shape's seed, scrambled so near shapes draw unlike ones.
const seedOf = shape => (Math.imul(shape + 1, 0x9e3779b1) ^ 0x5bd1e995) >>> 0;

// The ribs a shape draws: the design's for 0, another's a little wider or narrower and widening faster or slower.
function geoOf(shape) {
  if (!shape) return T.geo;
  const rand = dice(seedOf(shape) ^ 0x2545f491);
  const between = (least, most) => least + (most - least) * rand();
  rand();
  const widen = between(0.8, 1.25);
  return {
    ...T.geo,
    p0: T.geo.p0 * between(0.8, 1.3),
    betaP: T.geo.betaP * widen,
    betaM: T.geo.betaM * widen,
    phase: T.geo.phase + rand()
  };
}

// The ribs: circles |p - (C + s dir)| = R0 + g s, p from the box's middle in diagonals, the pitch in s growing away
// from s0, so the rib index k(s) is a logarithm; `turn` turns them about the middle.
function ribs(W, H, turn, geo) {
  const c = Math.cos(turn);
  const sn = Math.sin(turn);
  const rot = v => [v[0] * c - v[1] * sn, v[0] * sn + v[1] * c];
  const g = { ...geo, arcC: rot(geo.arcC), arcDir: rot(geo.arcDir) };
  const D = Math.hypot(W, H);
  const levelAt = (X, Y) => {
    const q0 = (X - W / 2) / D - g.arcC[0];
    const q1 = (Y - H / 2) / D - g.arcC[1];
    const a2 = 1 - g.arcG * g.arcG;
    const b2 = -2 * (q0 * g.arcDir[0] + q1 * g.arcDir[1] + g.arcG * g.arcR0);
    const c2 = q0 * q0 + q1 * q1 - g.arcR0 * g.arcR0;
    return (-b2 - Math.sqrt(Math.max(b2 * b2 - 4 * a2 * c2, 0))) / (2 * a2);
  };
  const kOf = s => {
    const ds = s - g.s0;
    const b = ds >= 0 ? g.betaP : g.betaM;
    return (
      (b > 1e-5 ? (Math.sign(ds) * Math.log(1 + (b * Math.abs(ds)) / g.p0)) / b : ds / g.p0) +
      g.phase
    );
  };
  const sOf = k => {
    let lo = -5;
    let hi = 5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      const m = (lo + hi) / 2;
      if (kOf(m) < k) lo = m;
      else hi = m;
    }
    return (lo + hi) / 2;
  };
  return { g, D, levelAt, kOf, sOf };
}

// The ribs' tangent at the middle in degrees, which the colors' orbits lie along.
function alphaOf(angle, shape) {
  const turn = ((angle - DESIGN_ANGLE) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const c = Math.cos(turn);
  const sn = Math.sin(turn);
  const [x, y] = geoOf(shape).arcC;
  const cxA = -(x * c - y * sn);
  const cyA = -(x * sn + y * c);
  const nA = Math.hypot(cxA, cyA);
  return r3((Math.atan2(-cxA / nA, cyA / nA) * 180) / Math.PI);

// The lens across a rib, in pitches, v from -1 (its inner edge) to 1 (its outer).
const lensF = v =>
  -(
    T.lensA * v +
    T.lensB * v ** 3 +
    T.lensE * (v / Math.sqrt(Math.max(1 - T.lensKappa * T.lensKappa * v * v, 1e-3)) - v)

// What a size draws, whatever the colors: the ribs and their lens grays, the normal, the light, the blur and the
// filter's region.
function geometry(W, H, angle, shape) {

  const u = D / REF_D;
  const edgeK = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 16; i++) {
    for (const [x, y] of [
      [(i * W) / 16, 0],
      [(i * W) / 16, H],
      [0, (i * H) / 16],
      [W, (i * H) / 16]
    ])
      edgeK.push(kOf(levelAt(x, y)));
  }
  const k0 = Math.floor(Math.min(...edgeK)) - 1;
  const k1 = Math.ceil(Math.max(...edgeK)) + 1;

  const seamPx = Math.max(T.seamW * u, 1.2);

  let dmax = 1;
  for (let k = k0; k < k1; k++) {
    const sIn = sOf(k);
    const sOut = sOf(k + 1);
    const cx = W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + sOut * g.arcDir[0]) * D;
    const cy = H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + sOut * g.arcDir[1]) * D;
    const R = (g.arcR0 + g.arcG * sOut) * D;
    const pitch = (sOut - sIn) * (1 + g.arcG) * D;
    const seam = seamPx / pitch;
    const stops = [];
    for (let j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
      const x = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos((Math.PI * j) / N);
      const e = Math.abs(x - 0.5) - 0.5;
      const tt = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e + seam) / (2 * seam)));
      const band = tt * tt * (3 - 2 * tt);
      const uf = x * (1 - band) + (1 - x) * band;
      const d = lensF(2 * uf - 1) * pitch * T.disp;
      dmax = Math.max(dmax, Math.abs(d));
      stops.push([(R - pitch + x * pitch) / R, d]);

  }

  const scale = r2(2 * dmax);
  const ribList = raw.map(r => ({
    cx: r2(r.cx),
    cy: r2(r.cy),
    r: r2(r.R),
    stops: r.stops.map(([o, d]) => [
      r4(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, o))),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * d) / (scale / 2)))
    ])
  }));
  const sMid = levelAt(W / 2, H / 2);
  const cm = [
    W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + sMid * g.arcDir[0]) * D,
    H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + sMid * g.arcDir[1]) * D
  ];
  const nl = Math.hypot(W / 2 - cm[0], H / 2 - cm[1]);
  const n0 = [(W / 2 - cm[0]) / nl, (H / 2 - cm[1]) / nl];
  const t0 = [-n0[1], n0[0]];
  const L = Math.abs(W * t0[0]) + Math.abs(H * t0[1]);
  const nStops = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= 16; j++) {
    const x = -L / 2 + (L * j) / 16;
    const X = W / 2 + t0[0] * x;
    const Y = H / 2 + t0[1] * x;
    const s = levelAt(X, Y);
    const c = [
      W / 2 + (g.arcC[0] + s * g.arcDir[0]) * D,
      H / 2 + (g.arcC[1] + s * g.arcDir[1]) * D
    ];
    const l = Math.hypot(X - c[0], Y - c[1]);
    nStops.push([
      r4(j / 16),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * (X - c[0])) / l)),
      Math.round(255 * (0.5 + (0.5 * (Y - c[1])) / l))
    ]);
  }
  const normal = {
    x1: r2(W / 2 - (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y1: r2(H / 2 - (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    x2: r2(W / 2 + (t0[0] * L) / 2),
    y2: r2(H / 2 + (t0[1] * L) / 2),
    stops: nStops
  };
  const alpha = alphaOf(angle, shape);
  const sigma = r2(T.blur * u);
  const dBox = Math.floor((sigma * 3 * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)) / 4 + 0.5);
  const sigmaEff = Math.sqrt(
    dBox % 2 ? (dBox * dBox - 1) / 4 : (3 * dBox * dBox + 2 * dBox - 2) / 12
  );
  const shadeTable = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => {
    const x = (2 * i) / 16 - 1;
    return r4(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 0.5 * (1 + T.shade * (T.shadeSkew * x - x * x + 1 / 3)))));
  });
